services.name: Wildlife Conservation
services.desc: SCI Foundation conducts and funds science‑based wildlife conservation programs around the world. Our work addresses key challenges such as predator-prey dynamics, wildlife genetics, population monitoring, anti‑poaching initiatives, and applied management strategies that strengthen sustainable wildlife management. Since 2000, SCIF has invested more than $71 million in global conservation efforts, ensuring that decisions in the field are guided by credible, accurate science. Through partnerships with state agencies, researchers, and international wildlife authorities, SCIF supports research that delivers real‑world impact for species and ecosystems.
